answer: The economy spends reputation the way a market spends money: sparingly and against verified performance, so Sybil inflation is filtered out before it can compound into a decisive advantage. In practice this means a farm must spend real resources on every single alias, and that per-identity cost is what keeps the network honest at scale.. The design works because cost compounds over compute, time, and reputation, growing faster than the influence the cluster can extract. Consider a fable as the anchor of the cost. A voyage stands in for the reward an honest agent protects. And a mirror holds...
